name: Profile Complete Percentage
description: Displays a block showing how complete the current user's profile is, based on admin-selected user fields.
project_description: Profile Complete Percent (PCP) is an add-on that encourages users to finish their profile. An administrator selects which user (account) fields count toward completion, and the module provides a 'Profile Complete Percentage' block that shows the currently logged-in user their own completion percentage as a progress bar. As the user fills out more fields, the percentage rises. A 'next tip' link suggests one more field to fill in (chosen randomly or in fixed order), tells the user what percentage that would reach, and deep-links to the exact field on their account edit form. All data is computed on the fly, so activating or deactivating required fields updates the display immediately. Development was sponsored by LimoenGroen; the Drupal 8 port was done by Akash Jain.
